name: gakumas-produce-memory-deck
description: ブラウザ内保存のプロデュースメモリー管理帳

scripts.build: bun run validate:master && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run check:staging && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=gakumas-produce-memory-deck-staging --branch=main
scripts.check:staging: bun run build:staging && bun run verify:staging:local
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts 'playwright*.config.ts' wrangler.jsonc .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml package.json tsconfig.json components.json index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts 'playwright*.config.ts' wrangler.jsonc .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml package.json tsconfig.json components.json index.html
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
